summary: Backend-only testing for Batch 1 (ERRORHACKER). 31 pytest tests covering customer auth (register/login/me/logout/google), coupons CRUD + apply, AI chat (single+multi-turn), image uploads (multipart+base64), Telegram test endpoint, orders with/without auth, /me/orders, and existing /api/config + /api/orders. 30/31 passed. Only failure is a transient LLM budget cap on the Emergent LLM key (not a code defect) which surfaces as 502 'AI assistant temporarily unavailable' on /api/chat/message when the per-key budget tips over. Multi-turn chat passed in the same run, proving wiring is correct.

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 'AI assistant temporarily unavailable'. Backend logs show: litellm.BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.00147, Max budget: 0.001'. This is an EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap, not a code bug. The endpoint, model wiring (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), and multi-turn persistence (db.chat_history) all work correctly when budget is available.

action_items: Investigate Emergent LLM key budget cap — current key 'sk-emergent-fEb49Eb0c7970B2FcC' is throwing 'Budget has been exceeded' from LiteLLM (max budget 0.001 USD). Likely need a higher-quota key or budget reset.
Consider returning a 503 (instead of 502) on AI key budget exhaustion so clients can distinguish 'rate limited' from 'upstream broken'.
Optional: Set httponly/secure/samesite='none' may be blocked on non-HTTPS dev; works fine in this preview environment over HTTPS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines and starting to mix concerns (auth, coupons, chat, uploads, orders). Approaching the 700-line guideline — recommend splitting into modules: auth.py, coupons.py, chat.py, uploads.py, orders.py.

POST /api/orders silently swallows JWT decode errors via _get_user_from_request returning None. If a bad/expired token is provided via Authorization header, the order is created anonymously instead of returning 401. Consider distinguishing 'no token' from 'invalid token'.
_set_session_cookie hardcodes secure=True + samesite='none' — fine over HTTPS preview, but local-http dev (without HTTPS) will silently drop cookies. Not blocking for production.

Coupon apply doesn't increment 'used' counter on successful application — max_uses limit can never trigger. Either move counter increment into apply, or document that increment should happen only at order checkout.

Admin auth uses plaintext password compare in db.admin (line 208: body.password != creds.get('password')). Recommend hashing admin password too (bcrypt) per playbook. Token store is also in-memory (Mongo array but unbounded growth limited to last 10 — OK).

POST /api/coupons doesn't accept lowercase code variations consistently — body.code.upper() applied on create but PATCH /coupons/{code} also uppercases. Good. However DELETE /coupons/{code} uppercases; ensure callers use consistent case.

Chat endpoint persists user message before LLM call but doesn't persist failed responses — if AI fails, the user message is in db.chat_history without a bot reply, which may confuse future context loading.
GET /api/uploads/{uid} is public (no auth) — intentional for serving images, but enumeration via UUID4 is effectively safe. OK.
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per run (qa+<timestamp>@example.com) and seed coupons HACK20 (percent 20) and HACK50 (flat 50). HACK20/HACK50 remain in DB after test run (idempotent — re-runs delete + recreate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_batch1_backend.py auto-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_batch1_backend.py -v`. Only the single-shot chat test is flaky due to Emergent LLM key budget cap (LiteLLM 'Budget has been exceeded'); if both chat tests fail it means budget is fully exhausted — request a key with more headroom. All other endpoints are stable. HACK20/HACK50 coupons may already exist in DB — tests handle this via pre-delete.
rca of the issue: Chat 502: Root cause = Emergent LLM key budget exceeded (LiteLLM BadRequestError 'Current cost: 0.00147, Max budget: 0.001'). Reproduction: POST /api/chat/message with a fresh session_id after key has accumulated >$0.001 in cost. Mitigation: Provision an Emergent LLM key with higher budget OR reset/cycle the key. Code wiring is correct — anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 model name is valid and multi-turn calls work when budget allows.
